name: MTU-Bench
description: MTU-Bench is a multi-granularity tool-use benchmark for large language models covering five tool usage scenarios including single-turn and multiple-turn interactions with single or multiple tools, as well as out-of-distribution tasks. It uses transformed existing datasets to simulate real-world tool usage and employs automatic evaluation metrics without relying on GPT or human evaluation.
reputation: A recent tool-use benchmark that has gained attention for covering multi-turn and out-of-distribution tool-use settings with automatic evaluation.
notes: Addresses limitations of existing tool-use benchmarks by covering diverse scenarios and reducing evaluation costs; includes an instruction dataset MTU-Instruct.
